title: The Perfect and Pluperfect Subjunctive
subtitle: amāverim / amāvissem.
objectives: Translate in subordinate clauses as 'may have', 'might have', 'had'.

sections.heading: Perfect and pluperfect subjunctive
sections.body:
Perfect subjunctive: perfect stem + -erim, -eris, -erit, -erimus, -eritis, -erint:
  amāverim, amāveris, amāverit, etc.

Pluperfect subjunctive: perfect stem + -issem, -issēs, -isset, -issēmus, -issētis, -issent:
  amāvissem, amāvissēs, amāvisset, etc.

Cicero writes: nesciō quid fēcerim. — I do not know what I may have done.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you can form all four subjunctive tenses.
